summary: Comprehensive testing of iteration 116 features: ticket_number mandatory, ad-hoc email, and standardized progress. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend testing verified: ticket_number field in assign dialog (required), ticket display in projects table and detail page, ticket search, Avance (progress) column with progress bars, ad-hoc email dialog with recipients/subject/message/attachments, progress banner for single projects.
